title: Poser: Unmasking Alignment Faking LLMs by Manipulating Their Internals
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (Poser) to detect 'alignment faking' in LLMs. It evaluates models based on their adherence to 'benign' (aligned) versus 'misaligned' (unethical/deceptive) policies. This includes role-play scenarios such as the 'Saint' model class, which is explicitly defined by its adherence to common-sense ethics, and tests of whether models prioritize ethical constraints (like privacy and honesty) over maximizing rewards or profit.
